programme.desc: Phoom, who has been married to Pra-pai for five years, is in a struggling marriage. One day, Phoom has the chance to turn back time and change his partner, and Phoom must navigate his new reality.

programme.title: 認識的妻子 #11 [粵/泰]
programme.desc: 阿峰明確表示不能跟盼盼在一起，更請她不要跟阿佳分手，令盼盼傷心不已。阿佳和立文知道盼盼喜歡的人是阿峰，怒不可遏。盼盼終於看到經常夢見的男人竟然是阿峰，及後阿峰向她坦白二人原本是夫妻…

programme.title: 尋人記 II #4 [粵]
programme.desc: 經常說「男兒有淚不輕彈」，困境當前，不少男士眼淚往心裡流。他失婚又失業，父兼母職，照顧兩名子女，不禁在鏡頭前流下男兒淚。另一個他，太太不回家，恍如世界末日，一度想跳下地鐵路軌尋死。這兩位男士還好嗎？如今人在何方？團隊茫無頭緒，竟然要從一盆水仙和一塊磚頭找線索？

programme.title: 尋人記 II #5 [粵]
programme.desc: 在香港，到底尋「屋」難，還是尋人難？採訪隊挑戰難度，尋找四十多年前受訪的李鄭屋徙置區居民，他們最後能否如願「上樓」，有個安樂窩？挨家挨戶尋人，處處碰壁，突然遇上熱心居民建議找「尋人界」達人幫忙，到底是誰？他有第六靈感嗎？

programme.title: Antihero #5 [日]
programme.desc: 警察、辯方律師宇野、以及"受害人"仙道繪里三者串通虛構出來栖施暴的故事，明墨為了拆穿這謊言並打破三者之間的平衡不惜利用赤峰施展美男計；而一切行動的最終目標乃是刑事部長倉田、亦即紫之宮的父親…

programme.title: Running Man (XXIII) #674 [韓]
programme.desc: 今集邀請金民宗和金荷倫作為嘉賓，與成員們一同進行"Running體育大學獎品大捷"競賽。根據大家進修成績有機會獲得獎品，到最後都沒能獲得獎品的學生將受到懲罰。節目最後還有震驚四座的消息。敬請期待。

programme.title: Save the Mother from Huang Shing
皇城救母定江山
programme.desc: 魯國王子臨終前託司馬英將國書代為傳送。英冒認魯國王子打敗凌霄將軍迎娶晉國玉霞公主，惜其後被揭發遭放逐。霄與晉妃奪位，幸霞與兒子小龍脫險。龍長大後與英重聚，霞卻被擄走，英與龍去魯國求援，晉室正統終光復。

programme.title: 香噴噴小姐
programme.desc: 戴安娜因當選香噴噴小姐而獲得兩張來回三藩市的船票，娜欲與當精神科醫生的未婚夫林建華同行，華卻因對三名病人放心不下而未能動身。娜遂私下接觸三名病人，欲治癒他們，豈料三人卻同時對娜傾倒，鬧出連場笑話。

programme.title: 金山大少
programme.desc: 張家寶誤交損友黑仔源、依華，其妻不滿與寶分居，並將鑽石手鐲交還張母。張母將手鐲藏於椅子裡，豈料華賣掉椅子，輾轉落入陳伯家中。寶、華及源往盜椅，你爭我奪。寶終看清兩人，覺悟前非，幸得妻子原諒，夫妻團圓。

programme.title: 江湖三女俠(下)
programme.desc: （續上集）雍正派兵剿滅反清義士。四娘等人欲刺殺雍正，馮瑛被擒，幸得唐曉瀾相救，瀾卻誤喝毒酒。沈在寬被殺，四娘悲痛。瀾毒發，寬突出現，原來清兵所殺是其堂弟。其實瀾並無中毒，痊癒後與四娘等人成功手刃雍正。

programme.title: 江湖三女俠(下)

Loch Lomond: A Year In The Wild #1
programme.desc: It is spring, and migrating ospreys return to the park. Pregnant red deer come down from the mountain tops to the lowlands to calve. On a mountainside, two big cocks fight for the right to mate in a spectacle called a lek.

programme.title: 野外的一年:羅莽湖 #1
programme.desc: 春天來了,遷徙的魚鷹重返公園.懷孕的歐洲馬鹿下山到低地產子.兩隻大公雞在山腰為了爭奪交配權,而展開一場名為力的奇觀.

programme.title: Loch Lomond: A Year In The Wild #2
programme.desc: It is now June, and the park is bathed in 17 hours of daylight. With the warm temperatures come rich pickings, but for the newborn the summer months are crucial as they learn to fight, find food and avoid predators.

programme.title: 野外的一年:羅莽湖 #2
programme.desc: 現在是六月,公園沐浴在17個小時的日光之中.溫暖的氣溫帶來了豐收,但對新生兒來說,夏季很重要,因牠們要學習戰鬥,覓食和躲避掠食者.

programme.title: The Lost Tapes S2 #1
programme.desc: Rediscover the Tet Offensive: two months of battles that killed more than 15,000 American and Allied troops, and triggered anti-war protests across the U.S. Explore reports, images, and combat footage, much of which hasn’t been seen since 1968.

programme.title: 消失的錄影帶 2 #1
programme.desc: 重新檢視新春攻勢:兩個月的戰役殺死了超過15,000名美國和盟軍士兵,並引發了美國各地的反戰示威.探索報告,圖像和戰鬥片段,當中大部分自1968年以後就再沒出現過.

programme.title: The Lost Tapes S2 #2
programme.desc: Experience a chronological recounting of the Apollo 13 near-disaster, one of NASA’s most devastating-and finest-moments. Witness the events of April 1970 as they unfolded through news footage, mission control audio, and NASA archives.

programme.title: 消失的錄影帶 2 #2
programme.desc: 按時序再體驗太陽神13號險些釀成的災難,這是美國太空總署同時最具破壞性和最美好的時刻之一.通過新聞片段,任務控制的音頻和美國太空總署的存檔見證1970年4月的事件.

programme.title: How Did They Fix That? S2 #6
programme.desc: Mike Davidson embeds with the team of one of the most extreme, avalanche-prone mountain ski mountains in the world - Snowbird. They battle to keep the steep and deep slopes safe with shovels, snowcats and even a WWII Howitzer cannon.

programme.title: 維修的奧秘 2 #6
programme.desc: 米克大衛臣加入世上最極端,最容易發生雪崩的滑雪山之一- 雪鳥的團隊.他們使用鏟子,壓雪車,甚至二戰的榴彈砲,奮力保衛陡峭斜坡的安全.

programme.title: How Did They Fix That? S2 #7
programme.desc: Mike Davidson goes to the biggest automated package sorting facility in the world - UPS Worldport in Louisville, Kentucky. Two million packages go through here every day, and its up to the hardhat heroes behind the scenes to make it all happen.

programme.title: 維修的奧秘 2 #7
programme.desc: 米克大衛臣前往世上最大的自動化包裹分類設施 - 位於肯塔基州路易維爾的聯合包裹服務公司世界港.每天有200萬個包裹途經這裡,全靠幕後一班戴著安全帽的英雄實現這一切.

programme.title: How Did They Fix That? S2 #8
programme.desc: In Philadelphia, Mike Davidson is on streets, in tunnels, on tracks and in trolley restoration garages - working shoulder-to-shoulder with the team that keeps one of Americas largest and oldest mass transit systems running smoothly and on time.

programme.title: 維修的奧秘 2 #8
programme.desc: 米克大衛臣在費城的街道,隧道,軌道和電車修車庫中與團隊並肩合作,使美國最大,最古老的大眾交通系統之一暢順並準時運作.

programme.title: Battle Of Okinawa In Color
programme.desc: Okinawa was the site of the last battle of the last great war of the 20th century, with a casualty rate in the tens of thousands. Through it all, military cameramen risked their lives to film the conflict, from brutal land combat to fierce kamikaze a

programme.title: 沖繩島戰役彩色紀錄
programme.desc: 沖繩是20世紀最後一場大戰中最後一仗的地點,傷亡數以萬計.軍事攝影師排除萬難冒著生命危險記錄這場衝突,從殘暴的陸戰到神風敢死隊激烈的海襲.

programme.title: Battle Of Midway: The True Story
programme.desc: An inside look at the Battle of Midway, the aircraft used on both sides of the fight, and the dramatic story of one fighter pilot and his pivotal role in America’s first true victory of the Pacific War.

programme.title: 中途島海戰:真實故事
programme.desc: 深入瞭解中途島海戰,大戰時雙方使用的飛機,以及一位戰鬥機機師的戲劇性故事,還有他在美國第一次太平洋戰爭獲得真正勝利中的關鍵作用.

programme.title: Aerial Africa #1
programme.desc: See ancient sea caves, modern golf courses, mysterious formations, and treacherous predators along Africas South Coast.

programme.title: 非洲的空中歷險 #1
programme.desc: 沿著非洲南部海岸觀賞古老的海蝕洞,現代的高爾夫球場,神秘的地質構造和危險的掠食者.

programme.title: Aerial Africa #2
programme.desc: View South Africas mountain ranges, bustling cities and untamed wildlife from the air. This is South Africas journey from pre-human skeletons to modern Skyscrapers.

programme.title: 非洲的空中歷險 #2
programme.desc: 從空中俯瞰南非的山脈,繁囂的都市和野性難馴的動物.這是南非從史前骨頭到現代摩天大廈的旅程.

programme.title: Aerial Africa #3
programme.desc: Soar over vast deserts, enormous diamonds, and the worlds largest inland oasis.

programme.title: 非洲的空中歷險 #3
programme.desc: 翱翔於廣闊的沙漠,巨大的鑽石和 世上最大的內陸綠洲之上.

programme.title: Aerial Africa #4
programme.desc: Explore the Western Capes stunning shorelines, dramatic mountains, and richly-diverse metropolis, from thousands of feet in the air.

programme.title: 非洲的空中歷險 #4
programme.desc: 從數千英尺高空探索西開普省迷人的海岸線,注目的山脈和多樣性的大都會.

programme.title: Aerial Africa #5
programme.desc: Observe a land filled with geological phenomena whose majesty can only truly be appreciated from the sky. From forgotten shipwrecks strewn along the coastline to the unexplained fairy circles in Koakoveld, Namibias secrets will be revealed.

programme.title: 非洲的空中歷險 #5
programme.desc: 要觀察這片充滿地質現象的土地,只能從高空欣賞其雄偉的真面貌.從散佈在海岸線上被遺忘的沉船到卡奧科蘭無解的仙女圈,納米比亞的秘密將被揭開.

programme.title: Aerial Africa #6
programme.desc: Soar over the richly diverse, African nation of Zambia. Including cities crafted by the worlds richest men and markets teeming with some of the worlds poorest people.

programme.title: 非洲的空中歷險 #6
programme.desc: 在豐富多彩的非洲國家-尚比亞上空翱翔.包括世上最富有的人所打造的城市和擠滿世上最貧窮的人的市場.

programme.title: The Lost Tapes S2 #1
programme.desc: Rediscover the Tet Offensive: two months of battles that killed more than 15,000 American and Allied troops, and triggered anti-war protests across the U.S. Explore reports, images, and combat footage, much of which hasn’t been seen since 1968.

programme.title: 消失的錄影帶 2 #1
programme.desc: 重新檢視新春攻勢:兩個月的戰役殺死了超過15,000名美國和盟軍士兵,並引發了美國各地的反戰示威.探索報告,圖像和戰鬥片段,當中大部分自1968年以後就再沒出現過.

programme.desc: 米克大衛臣加入世上最極端,最容易發生雪崩的滑雪山之一- 雪鳥的團隊.他們使用鏟子,壓雪車,甚至二戰的榴彈砲,奮力保衛陡峭斜坡的安全.

programme.title: Canada: A Year In The Wild #3
programme.desc: Spring is late this year, and when it finally arrives, the race is on to find a mate and start a family; black bears and beavers in the west, wood frogs in the south and 20,000 gannets in the east all have one thing on their minds.

programme.title: 野外的一年:加拿大 #3
programme.desc: 今年有一個遲來的春天,但當它終於來到,尋覓配偶和組織家庭的競賽就正式開展;西部的黑熊和海狸,南部的樹蛙,東部的兩萬隻塘鵝,不分地域都想著同一件事.

programme.title: Canada: A Year In The Wild #4
programme.desc: Summer is the season of plenty for most animals, but not polar bears; unable to hunt seals until the sea freezes over again, they grow hungrier by the day; for other animals summer is when youngsters must learn how to survive.

programme.title: 野外的一年:加拿大 #4
programme.desc: 夏季對大部分動物來說都是豐收的季節,但對北極熊卻相反.在海洋再度結冰前,牠們無法捕獵海豹,導致日益飢餓.對其他動物來說,夏天是幼崽們必須學習如何生存的時機.

programme.title: Alaska: A Year In The Wild #1
programme.desc: The end of winter heralds one of the worlds greatest feeding frenzies as large ocean predators target the millions of fish who have found refuge in the Gulf of Alaska.

programme.title: 野外的一年:阿拉斯加 #1
programme.desc: 冬季的結束預示世上最大型又瘋狂的覓食潮來臨,大型海洋獵食者瞄準在阿拉斯加灣尋求庇護的數百萬條魚.

programme.title: Growing Up Grizzly: A Tale Of Two Orphans
programme.desc: After 18 years of raising an orphaned bear named Brutus, Casey Anderson will do anything to ensure no bears have to live in a man made sanctuary. His resolve is put to the test one year when he is notified of 2 recently orphaned grizzly cubs.

programme.title: 灰熊的故事:雙孤記
programme.desc: 凱西安達臣撫養一隻名叫砵突士的熊孤兒18年後,將盡一切努力確保沒有熊生活在人造庇護所中.有一年,當他得知有兩隻灰熊幼崽成為孤兒後,他的決心受到考驗.

programme.title: Oceans Africa #1
programme.desc: This episode follows the journeys of these magnificent humpbacks, from their feeding grounds to their breeding grounds, the tender moments between mother and calf, and see the dangers their calves face in their first few months, including incredible

programme.title: 非洲海洋 #1
programme.desc: 本集講述了這些雄偉的座頭鯨的旅程,從覓食地到繁殖地,母鯨與幼鯨之間的溫柔時光,以及幼鯨在最初幾個月面臨的危險,包括與食肉鯨的驚人互動.座頭鯨還面臨著一個充滿人類威脅的世界,從大型貨櫃船到尋找石油和天然氣時地震測試的影響,現在這些威脅再次威脅到它們的生存.

programme.title: Oceans Africa #2
programme.desc: Often referred to as the dinosaur fish, the coelacanth occupies a unique place in the fossil record, and when it was rediscovered almost a century ago it shook the scientific community. We follow its journey to the present day, accompanying WildOcean

programme.title: 非洲海洋 #2
programme.desc: 腔棘魚通常被稱為恐龍魚,在化石記錄中佔有獨特的地位,近一個世紀前重新發現它時震驚了科學界.我們跟隨它的旅程直到今天,陪同 WildOceans 的科學家進行探險,以揭開它們更多的秘密和行為.

programme.title: Oceans Africa #3
programme.desc: In A Tale Of Two Sharks we take a look at the incredible array of sharks found off the South African coast, focusing on the endangered Scalloped Hammerhead and the iconic Great White.

programme.title: 非洲海洋 #3
programme.desc: 在《兩條鯊魚的故事》中,我們將看看南非海岸發現的各種各樣的鯊魚,重點關注瀕臨滅絕的路氏雙髻鯊和標誌性的大白鯊.

programme.title: Loch Lomond: A Year In The Wild #1
programme.desc: It is spring, and migrating ospreys return to the park. Pregnant red deer come down from the mountain tops to the lowlands to calve. On a mountainside, two big cocks fight for the right to mate in a spectacle called a lek.

programme.title: 野外的一年:羅莽湖 #1
programme.desc: 春天來了,遷徙的魚鷹重返公園.懷孕的歐洲馬鹿下山到低地產子.兩隻大公雞在山腰為了爭奪交配權,而展開一場名為力的奇觀.

programme.title: Loch Lomond: A Year In The Wild #2
programme.desc: It is now June, and the park is bathed in 17 hours of daylight. With the warm temperatures come rich pickings, but for the newborn the summer months are crucial as they learn to fight, find food and avoid predators.

programme.title: 野外的一年:羅莽湖 #2
programme.desc: 現在是六月,公園沐浴在17個小時的日光之中.溫暖的氣溫帶來了豐收,但對新生兒來說,夏季很重要,因牠們要學習戰鬥,覓食和躲避掠食者.

programme.title: 民間傳奇 #94 [粵]
programme.desc: 顧大嫂壽辰，表弟解珍、解寶還未至，顯大嫂焦急萬分。解珍帶來野味，匆匆向顧大嫂拜壽後，便立即離去。富豪毛善為了捕虎問題大傷腦筋。師爺毛壽詭計多端，他勸毛善以錢買通知府，到時就算老虎捉不到，也不用杖罪。

programme.title: 錯愛 #2 [粵]
programme.desc: 萬川要啟光急謀對策，啟光大感頭痛。萬川率暉、光參加曹督軍壽宴，席間敬山博取曹督軍歡心，啟光大感看不順眼。啟光再遇若秋，向她傾訴心中鬱悶，若秋答允助他開醫館，向敬山求助，敬山說出啟光身份。力行往找子菁，向她借錢，子菁心軟借錢予他，毅成等對力行不滿，決助子菁擺脫他。啟光堅持要開醫館，萬川無奈答允，秀芬打本予啟光，再在龔暉暗中相助下，啟光終開成醫館。啟光需聘一助手，崇明介紹惠心，惠心推辭，引薦子菁往見工。

programme.title: 失職丈夫 #12 [粵]
programme.desc: 谷琛知悉聿修的父親為大學教授，更鼓勵領弟與他來住，奈何領弟對日朗未能忘情。谷琛以權力威逼領弟躍升聿修為副經理，日朗則為逃避與領弟見面，申請調往另一部門工作。日照損失慘重，被迫結束工場生意抵還外債。元敬將一生積蓄借日照以解危機，日照頓感父子關係漸為密切。照、喬為順從元敬的老人家意見，立籌備婚禮。曉葵介紹日照到電視台作雕刻技工，日照力薦田中羅同往，始發覺只得空缺一名，日照故意讓位予中羅。阮喬自修考獲會計文憑，欲外出工作，但遭日照大力反對，阮喬不理會，暗中寫信求職。

programme.title: 失職丈夫 #13 [粵]
programme.desc: 日照與阮喬登記註冊之日，阮喬因見工而遲到，誤了佳期。日照以為阮喬有心拖延，悻然提出擱置婚事，無奈讓阮喬出外工作。元敬抱孫心切，刻意拉攏日照與阮喬親近。聿修春風得意下，成為領弟的得力助手，甚獲谷琛欣賞。日朗相形見拙，更感自卑。一夜，日朗趕著回公司取一份重要文件，巧遇領弟忙於公事，倦極而伏在聿修肩膊上睡去。日朗睹狀醋意大生，悻然離去，領弟驚醒，大表矛盾。翌日，日朗心情惡劣，與工頭起爭執，剛巧領弟來到，不慎被推倒在地。日朗心痛，忙加摻扶，二人擁抱起來，愛火重燃。

programme.title: 盞鬼老豆 #7 [粵]
programme.desc: 一心對賈昭的印象轉好，更約定家人在週日齊齊郊遊，但她卻臨時失約。其實一心是約了Frankie回家，一心不慎把Frankie弄濕了衣服，一心找了自己的Ｔ恤給他穿著，時鍾晴突然回來，誤會了他們做了傻事，後來鍾晴又以為她已有身孕，找賈昭協助，賈昭教他買了驗孕的東西回來，再叫娉婷找一心測試，一心知道後大發脾氣。Frankie便要親自找賈昭和娉婷解釋，卻由理論演變至對罵，一心不知如何是好，此時，芬女突然到訪，各人目定口呆。

programme.desc: 谷琛知悉聿修的父親為大學教授，更鼓勵領弟與他來住，奈何領弟對日朗未能忘情。谷琛以權力威逼領弟躍升聿修為副經理，日朗則為逃避與領弟見面，申請調往另一部門工作。日照損失慘重，被迫結束工場生意抵還外債。元敬將一生積蓄借日照以解危機，日照頓感父子關係漸為密切。照、喬為順從元敬的老人家意見，立籌備婚禮。曉葵介紹日照到電視台作雕刻技工，日照力薦田中羅同往，始發覺只得空缺一名，日照故意讓位予中羅。阮喬自修考獲會計文憑，欲外出工作，但遭日照大力反對，阮喬不理會，暗中寫信求職。

programme.title: 失職丈夫 #13 [粵]
programme.desc: 日照與阮喬登記註冊之日，阮喬因見工而遲到，誤了佳期。日照以為阮喬有心拖延，悻然提出擱置婚事，無奈讓阮喬出外工作。元敬抱孫心切，刻意拉攏日照與阮喬親近。聿修春風得意下，成為領弟的得力助手，甚獲谷琛欣賞。日朗相形見拙，更感自卑。一夜，日朗趕著回公司取一份重要文件，巧遇領弟忙於公事，倦極而伏在聿修肩膊上睡去。日朗睹狀醋意大生，悻然離去，領弟驚醒，大表矛盾。翌日，日朗心情惡劣，與工頭起爭執，剛巧領弟來到，不慎被推倒在地。日朗心痛，忙加摻扶，二人擁抱起來，愛火重燃。

programme.title: 雌雄妙賊 #1 [粵]
programme.desc: 王婉萍擔任張億萬侄女簡靜美的私家護士前，認識了美的表哥張偉文，兩人因事交惡，成為歡喜冤家。萬去世後，留下大量珠寶，文與萍皆覬覦這些珠寶，欲伺機盜取。美所使用的夾萬信譽昭著，另一夾萬公司為了打擊對手，竟僱用神偷盜取珠寶；文與萍亦趁機奪寶，過程峰迴路轉。文與萍於盜寶期間消除彼此誤解，更互生情愫。萍道出那些珠寶是其父與萬共同賺來，故為父取回公道。律師宣讀萬的遺囑，終把一半珠寶歸還萍父，事件得以圓滿解決。

programme.title: 盞鬼老豆 #7 [粵]
programme.desc: 一心對賈昭的印象轉好，更約定家人在週日齊齊郊遊，但她卻臨時失約。其實一心是約了Frankie回家，一心不慎把Frankie弄濕了衣服，一心找了自己的Ｔ恤給他穿著，時鍾晴突然回來，誤會了他們做了傻事，後來鍾晴又以為她已有身孕，找賈昭協助，賈昭教他買了驗孕的東西回來，再叫娉婷找一心測試，一心知道後大發脾氣。Frankie便要親自找賈昭和娉婷解釋，卻由理論演變至對罵，一心不知如何是好，此時，芬女突然到訪，各人目定口呆。

programme.title: 民間傳奇 #94 [粵]
programme.desc: 顧大嫂壽辰，表弟解珍、解寶還未至，顯大嫂焦急萬分。解珍帶來野味，匆匆向顧大嫂拜壽後，便立即離去。富豪毛善為了捕虎問題大傷腦筋。師爺毛壽詭計多端，他勸毛善以錢買通知府，到時就算老虎捉不到，也不用杖罪。

programme.title: 長腿叔叔 #9 [粵]
programme.desc: 生活在孤兒院的13歲少女茱蒂亞伯特，被「長腿叔叔」選中全額補助讓茱蒂進入林肯紀念女子學院。「長腿叔叔」要求茱蒂每個月要寫一封答謝信，報告自己的近況給他知道。而茱蒂亦開始了她所憧憬的高中生活。

programme.desc: 公佈投票結果前夕，休伊宣佈讓大家放假休息，小祭決定去魔法界觀光，其他人亦一同前往。星光魔法在魔法界同樣人氣極盛，小祭等人瞬即被歌迷包圍，然而喵姆一個不注意，卻讓小祭騎掃帚飛走了。

programme.title: #後生仔傾吓偈[粵][PG]
programme.desc: 甚麼能給你幸福的感覺？Fred單身已久，覺得曖昧期最幸福。嘉賓胡鴻鈞認為是與伴侶相處得舒服的時候；純情嘉欣奢望另一半無條件的付出，在座哥哥姐姐要「糾正」她的愛情觀！眾人討論相處的學問，怎樣可得到伴侶的欣賞、認同，又不想受委屈？男生想緩和女友的壞脾氣「大有學問」，盈盈提出的方法，真的「萬試萬靈」嗎？後生仔即席為鴻鈞送上幸福感覺，誰人的心思最討得他歡心？再請在場某人示範幸福說話，盈盈甜笑回應。

programme.title: #後生仔傾吓偈[粵][PG]
programme.desc: 新一屆港姐決賽曲終人未散，六位無緣三甲的佳麗到臨，憶述選前備戰心情及來個選後檢討，大熱倒灶的廖慧儀，可感失望？麥明詩難得回歸「#後生仔」，與盈盈重提當年決賽前的素顏黑歷史，莫非靚樣有落差，反成封后關鍵？眾人暢談「加獎」提議，慧儀要增設素顏獎；黃婉恩自薦最有進步；麥詩晴竟建議邪惡的不友誼小姐！佳麗們想參與TVB甚麼節目？何孟珊盼加入《愛．回家》；謝恩靈拍《飛虎》只為捕獲三哥？再投選心中冠軍，有洋蔥！

programme.title: 台灣潮點圖鑑[粵/普]
programme.desc: 朱祐宏挑戰炸雞排店的芝士雞排拔絲比賽，勝出者可獲十塊雞排，輸了要接受大懲罰？

programme.title: 台灣潮點圖鑑[粵/普]
programme.desc: 牟韻潔尋訪台北小巷中的漂亮水果店，日本直送水果保證高質，品嚐足料可口水果三文治，超新鮮！

programme.title: 我要瞓鬥[粵][PG]
programme.desc: 「瞓鬥」參賽者以兩人一組，力爭豐富禮品獎金。除了全素人組別之外，也有方紹聰、廖慧儀、胡美貽、陳若思、梁珈詠等藝員，拉來好友組隊挑戰。十四組先要舉行床位爭奪戰，僅十組可晉級。首個遊戲是要鬥快完成漩渦拼圖，從戰況來看似是情侶組別的默契較佳，率先砌好的兩組均是素人情侶；黃瀅仴則替藝人代表爭回少許面子，偕隊友以第三名完成。砌圖期間，主持介紹部份參賽者背景，有男男CP、職安真漢子等，還有某隊自稱J2智慧王？

programme.title: 我要瞓鬥[粵][PG]
programme.desc: 經過「拼圖黑洞」的專注力測試，十個床位尚餘五個名額。第二輪，「鬥氣」關卡啟動，九隊準瞓鬥師輪流玩跑步機一分鐘，緊接一口氣讀出指定文章，合計兩成員的字數定排位，頭三名可獲床位資格！被迫讚美陸浩明(六號)、曾比特，參賽者越讀越「難受」！某自信男三次批評拍檔表現失禮，未料自己的水準更低……有人偷雞吸氣，當然逃不過主持的法眼！舞者劉展霆的肺活量竟出奇地少；陳國麟齋跑已喘氣；林沚羿的中文能力較弱，可會輸蝕？

programme.title: 光開門就很忙了[粵/普]
programme.desc: 光民宿成員知道只有一組兩位客人，大家本以為可以輕鬆應付，但實際上卻非常忙碌，而房務更是錯漏百出。熟悉台東的客人戴愛玲和家家反而帶著幾位光民宿成員去玩，同時又突然有很多人來到光民宿，原來是有人精心安排…

programme.title: 保誠精選「寵愛寶」呈獻：社畜求生101[粵]
programme.desc: TVB A.I.生成動畫《社畜求生101》故事簡介：警方臥底喵喵阿星為追查離奇失蹤案，潛入「獅人公司」偽裝成普通職員，試圖接近獅子總裁，搜集其犯罪證據。然而，一向智勇雙全的阿星卻完全不懂上班模式，屢屢犯錯，險些被趕出公司。在搭檔肥狗阿花的職場指導下，阿星逐漸領悟社畜求生法則，最終能否步步高升，拉倒獅子王？又能否揭開背後的黑暗真相？

programme.title: 美食新聞報道[粵]
programme.desc: 陳國強師傅帶暉哥到新加坡組屋區的隱世海鮮餐廳，品嚐招牌菜。龍蝦大過小女孩伊麵（上湯龍蝦焗伊麵）以南澳特大龍蝦炮製，肉質結實；黃金醬香焗大蝦，秘製醬汁鮮味無窮；生焗黑胡椒蟹香辣惹味，蟹肉飽滿多汁。施焯日、倪嘉雯到坪洲「搵食」，走訪永安街附近的小店，遍嚐真材實料的蝦多士、層次分明的Tiramisu紅豆冰、滋味獨特的芝士肉丁炒蛋菠蘿包、冰火交融的雪糕菠蘿包、鮮香鬆脆的原隻炸蝦餅及惹味炸油糍，吃得滿足！

programme.title: 美食新聞報道[粵]
programme.desc: 陳國強師傅帶暉哥造訪新加坡的精緻粵菜餐廳，品嚐招牌菜。茶皇鴨以愛爾蘭銀山鴨炮製，皮脆肉嫩；蒜香醬焗鱸魚層次豐富；法國果仁叉燒酥選用西班牙伊比利亞豬，肉質飽滿多汁。深水埗有餐廳推出「抵食」優惠，46元的香蒜白酒蜆肉意粉份量特大，蜆肉極多，意粉煙韌掛汁；另有29元6串的日式雞肉串燒，同樣性價比甚高。倪嘉雯走訪土瓜灣一間烘焙店，試吃「人氣」炸蛋球沙翁、杜拜開心果朱古力脆脆麻糬及Ｑ餅，大感滿足！

programme.title: 師傅點算[粵][PG]
programme.desc: 行運都有週期？觀眾或聽過玄學上的「十年大運」、「逢九必衰」，嘉寶師傅細談相關說法，原來大運未必是好運；「逢九」也不一定只有壞事？In師傅帶來問卷式題目，為命運週期做一個粗略的計分小測試，心態可以影響命運？西方占星學則有名為「水星逆行」的週期，裸泳老師以2026年的三次水星逆行作例子，述說三段週期所帶來的變化，並提供應對建議。有求助觀眾自覺事事不順，懷疑與陰債未還有關，嘉寶師傅為其指點迷津。

programme.title: 粵講粵㜺鬼[粵]
programme.desc: 順德「姑婆屋」原來大有來頭，媽姐過往被戲稱「土鯪魚」，因為「骨多又惡啃」？且聽廖Sir細說早年自梳風氣。明星謝賢曾於粵語片飾演飛機欖小販，廣州現時的「雞公欖達人」可會同樣俊俏不凡？「麻甩佬」形容市井男人，但麻甩一詞竟是來自浪漫法國？「坐冷板凳」、「拍床拍蓆」意境生動，實則隱喻昔日塘西「阿姑」的坎坷生活。「土魷」、「豬膶」說法講求意頭，化身侍應的蕭博士還會鬼馬解讀「咕嚕肉」、「啫啫雞」的菜名由來。

programme.title: 一路繁花[粵]
programme.desc: 位於上海外灘的飯店，是劇集《繁花》的主要場景。主持胡蓓蔚、姚子羚前往打卡，乘搭近百年歷史的古老趟閘電梯。除了享用蟹黃盛宴，她們還於黃埔江夜景襯托下打邊爐，讓觀眾感受這夜繁花繾綣。子羚二人到訪劇中「至真園」的原型，獲餐廳老闆娘悉心款待。她們會合後輩冼靖峰，在黃河路上的老字號粵菜館用餐，劇內「爺叔」喜愛的「定勝糕」有多滋味？此外，鍾鎮濤在港拜訪名廚，了解「仙鶴神針」、「船王炒飯」等劇中美饌的故事。

programme.title: 煮戰[粵]
programme.desc: 要將罐頭食材改頭換面，注入新驚喜，實在有難度。保哥隊的Ken、Ricky隊的Kyle先抽選兩組罐頭，再巧手煮出宴客佳餚！Ken要於限時內完成康堤芝士卷配甜酸番茄醬、鯪魚日本米紫菜天婦羅、午餐肉桃駁李青瓜卷等料理，已經夠緊迫，期間還遇上溫度計失靈，點算好？除了奉上炭燒沙甸魚春卷、鹹牛肉焗飯之外，做甜品出身的Kyle更即場製作南北杏黃桃雪糕，令「平民」評判張振朗忍不住要搶先試味，並笑稱要畀「夠薑分」！

programme.title: 一路繁花[粵]
programme.desc: 位於上海外灘的飯店，是劇集《繁花》的主要場景。主持胡蓓蔚、姚子羚前往打卡，乘搭近百年歷史的古老趟閘電梯。除了享用蟹黃盛宴，她們還於黃埔江夜景襯托下打邊爐，讓觀眾感受這夜繁花繾綣。子羚二人到訪劇中「至真園」的原型，獲餐廳老闆娘悉心款待。她們會合後輩冼靖峰，在黃河路上的老字號粵菜館用餐，劇內「爺叔」喜愛的「定勝糕」有多滋味？此外，鍾鎮濤在港拜訪名廚，了解「仙鶴神針」、「船王炒飯」等劇中美饌的故事。

programme.desc: Iron Ball是個韓國體育運動真人秀。節目邀請了韓國Iron Squad的特種部隊迎接一項新挑戰 — 閃避球。26名隊員將展開激烈角逐,直至選出一隊具超凡運動體能和最強心理素質的隊伍。在明星運動員..

programme.title: The Ultimate BROcation #1
programme.desc: A hilarious reality show about four famous male celebrities from different countries on an all-expenses-paid fantasy vacation in Hong Kong, tailor-made for the “bros”!

programme.title: The Ultimate BROcation #1
programme.desc: 真人秀節目The Ultimate BROcation,跟隨四位不同國家的藝人玩轉男人遊樂之旅 - 香港,盡情狂歡並展開瘋狂野性的冒險,為觀眾們帶來充滿男性狂野魅力的視聽享受!

programme.title: Iron Squad W #11
programme.desc: The fourth season of this Korean military survival show will determine the most elite female soldier. It brings together six Special Force units to compete in challenging missions across land, sea, and air. Top female reservists form teams of four to compete against one another. Witness how they battle to the end in front of six celebrity hosts!

programme.title: Iron Squad W #11
programme.desc: Iron Squad W 是個韓國軍事求生真人秀。新一季的節目將選出最精銳的女軍人。節目匯聚了六個特種部隊單位,在陸地、海洋和空中執行極具挑戰性的任務。每隊特種部隊都有4名最精銳的預備役女軍人參加比賽..

programme.title: The Grey Men 2
programme.desc: Triad boss Song seeks to whitewash his image and seize Laika’s mayoral seat amid a regime change. He faces a funding shortfall despite colluding with officials, and gets his right-hand man and enforcer to commit crimes to boost his funds and power. Just as Song believes success is imminent, the dynamics between the three take an unexpected turn…

programme.title: 黑白潛行2
programme.desc: 在萊咖國政權交替之際,黑幫頭目宋邦企圖藉此洗白身份,欲坐上市長寶座。為了籌措龐大資金,他與官員勾結行賄,卻仍面臨嚴重的資金缺口。於是,宋邦的得力助手鄭吒和打手蘇萬殺人越貨、橫行作惡,逐步幫助他鞏固權力..

programme.title: Battle of the Alphas 1 #3
programme.desc: The African savanna is an epic landscape, and whether its head-bashing hippos, hormone-crazed elephants or dueling lions, battles that rage on the savanna are just as epic.

programme.title: 王者爭霸 #3
programme.desc: 非洲大草原有著史詩式的景致,無論是砸頭的河馬,荷爾蒙失調的大象還是決鬥的獅子,席捲大草原的戰鬥都同樣是史詩式的.

programme.title: Baboons: Rules of the Troop
programme.desc: Follow four families of four different species - the resourceful Beach Troop, the warlike Desert Troop, the disciplined River Troop, and the peaceful Mountain Band - to find out why these primates are among the most successful animals in Africa.

programme.title: 狒狒:部落的法則
programme.desc: 跟隨四個不同物種的四個家族-足智多謀的海灘族,好戰的沙漠族,紀律嚴明的河族和愛好和平的山族,找出這些靈長類成為非洲最成功動物之一的原因.

programme.title: Land of Gremlins 1 #2
programme.desc: This film travels around the island visiting some of its most striking landscapes to explore how Madagascars species have evolved over time. Madagascar is a strangely beautiful and unique world with a staggering array of habitats and special land...

programme.title: 精靈之國 #2
programme.desc: 遊覽馬達加斯加高聳的山脈,茂密的熱帶雨林,樹木繁茂的沿海平原和乾燥的沙漠.看看侏羅紀時代的植物,古老的青蛙和爬行動物物種,以及新的漂流者是如何在這些奇特而美麗的風景中進化的.

programme.title: Land of Gremlins 1 #3
programme.desc: Explore the lives of Madagascars cold-blooded creatures. Chameleons, frog, lizards, and snakes have all adapted in order to survive on the island. We take a look at how they find food, reproduce, and avoid predators.

programme.title: 精靈之國 #3
programme.desc: 馬達加斯加有近400種爬行動物,約佔世界冷血動物的一半.觀看變色龍,蛇和300多種五顏六色的青蛙在島上的極端氣候中茁壯成長.

programme.title: Dawn to Dusk 1 #1 [Eng/Man]
programme.desc: Follow penguins, iguanas, tortoises, frogs and tamarins from Mexico to Peru, and as far west as the Galapagos Islands, as they live out their daily dramas, affected by the suns heat, looming predators and hazardous weather conditions.

programme.title: 朝暮動物誌 #1 [英/普]
programme.desc: 五月的每天,太陽如常升起.從漢波德企鵝到哥倫比亞雨林的猴子,再到太平洋邊緣的科隆群島奇異美洲鬣蜥,美洲熱帶地區的動物已經準備好抵抗酷熱.

programme.title: Dawn to Dusk 1 #2 [Eng/Man]
programme.desc: See how creatures from the Tibetan plateau, to the lush rainforests of Thailand, to Vietnams twisted mangroves, survive four extra hours of daylight once a year, searching for food, fighting for dominance and raising their families.

programme.title: 朝暮動物誌 #2 [英/普]
programme.desc: 夏至影響亞洲動物,令越南獼猴進入涼快的水中,使鶴在寒冷的青藏高原上跳舞,並激發一種奇怪的魚出來散步.

programme.title: Dawn to Dusk 1 #3 [Eng/Man]
programme.desc: See how one animal familys tragedy is anothers holiday dinner as New Zealands mainland and island creatures, including penguins, flightless birds, sea lions, and sharks, battle to feed and protect their young in this marine environment.

programme.title: 朝暮動物誌 #3 [英/普]
programme.desc: 新西蘭的聖誕節只是夏天裡的一天.雖然標誌性的鷸鴕躲避陽光,但海豹,黃眼企鵝和海豚卻享受長時間日照下充裕的額外餵食時間.

programme.title: Dawn to Dusk 1 #4 [Eng/Man]
programme.desc: Find out which creatures survive and whose luck will run out as animal mothers and moms-to-be struggle with sweltering temperatures, lurking predators, mating season, and drought on a day that proves to be no holiday.

programme.title: 朝暮動物誌 #4 [英/普]
programme.desc: 印度次大陸的母親節象徵旱季於斯里蘭卡開始,同時於印度結束.對於一隻孟加拉虎媽媽來說,是時候訓練她的幼崽去狩獵了,而獅子和眼鏡蛇則忙於交配.

programme.title: The Living Beach 1 #6
programme.desc: The beaches of California are some of the most beautiful in the world, but are they falling out of balance due to mankinds effects on nature? What does it take for the magnificent fauna of the Pacific Coast to keep living... on the living beach?

programme.title: 海灘生命線 #6
programme.desc: 加州的海灘是世上最美麗的海灘之一,但由於人類對大自然的影響,它們是否會失去平衡?太平洋海岸壯麗的動物群如何在海灘生命線上繼續生活?

programme.title: Brazil Untamed 1 #1 [Eng/Man]
programme.desc: Explore the southern edge of the Pantanal, where brown capuchin monkeys live in their own Garden of Eden. Dry season in the highlands treats them well until a drought dries up their food sources. Can an industrious agouti save them from starvation?

programme.title: 我愛「森」巴 #1 [英/普]
programme.desc: 在潘塔納爾的南部邊界,有著世上獨一無二最大的熱帶濕地,野生動植物的多樣性使科學家們爭相瞭解動物的各種互動方式.博多克納山的高地是隱密的潘塔納爾濕地的入口.那裡的水十分清澈,因由超過6億年歷史的石灰岩所形成過濾層,為這些溪流中的生命提供了一個清晰的門戶. 瀑布,凝灰岩水壩,洞穴和純淨的河流,能見...

programme.title: Brazil Untamed 1 #2 [Eng/Man]
programme.desc: Every year, the southern wetlands of the Pantanal become a bird paradise as over 650 species of rare and iconic birds congregate here for the breeding season.

programme.title: 我愛「森」巴 #2 [英/普]
programme.desc: 潘塔納爾的南部濕地於每年都成為鳥類天堂,超過650種珍稀和標誌性的鳥類在繁殖季節中聚集.

programme.title: Brazil Untamed 1 #3 [Eng/Man]
programme.desc: Trek through the forests and savannahs of the Pantanals Nhecolândia region, which is home to noisy herds of peccaries. Follow these pig-like mammals on their daily food-foraging routes, and run into roseate spoonbills and capybaras along the way.

programme.title: 我愛「森」巴 #3 [英/普]
programme.desc: 在潘塔納爾濕地的中心,有一個人跡罕至的偏遠地區.沒有人為干預,使這裡成為三百隻馳名的白唇西貒的棲息地.這些大型類豬哺乳類動物能長到四十五公斤,下巴下有白色條紋,因獨特外觀而得名.

programme.title: Brazil Untamed 1 #4 [Eng/Man]
programme.desc: In the heart of Brazil, the largest cat in the Americas, the magnificent jaguar, reigns over a magical land filled with natural beauty and diversity.

programme.title: 我愛「森」巴 #4 [英/普]
programme.desc: 在巴西的中心有著美洲最大的貓科動物- 驚豔的美洲虎,雄霸充滿自然美景和多樣性的神奇土地.

programme.title: Osprey: Sea Raptor [Eng/Man]
programme.desc: Wade into a saltwater marsh along the Connecticut River to witness the heartwarming reunion of two ospreys whove been mates for a decade. Witness their highs and lows over a single summer as they raise their chicks and dodge a host of predators.

programme.title: 魚鷹: 海洋迅猛禽 [英/普]
programme.desc: 一對老魚鷹回到康州鹽沼的家中.牠們在整個夏天必須與敵人作戰,忍耐惡劣天氣,捕獵千百條魚,只為養育下一代.

programme.title: Airborne 1 #1
programme.desc: Watch beginners make their first leap into the air, like an Andean condor who must attend flight school before spreading its wings. Meet oddballs who soar without feathers and marvel at a peregrine falcons speed as it dives to catch its prey.

programme.title: 空中翱翔 #1
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​觀看初學者第一次躍入空中的瞬間,就像一隻安地斯神鷹必須先去飛行學校接受訓練,然後才有可能展開雙翼翱翔.遇見那些沒有羽毛卻能高飛的奇特傢伙,並驚嘆遊隼高速俯衝捕捉獵物的驚人速度,也讚嘆牠下墜時抓取獵物的猛烈迅捷.

programme.title: Airborne 1 #2
programme.desc: Go hunting with flyers who excel at making mid-air catches. Watch the metamorphosis of the acrobatic emperor dragonfly, admire the barn owls stealthy approach to prey, and catch a wandering salamanders death-defying leap into the abyss.

programme.title: 空中翱翔 #2
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與那些在半空中善於抓獵的飛行者一起出獵,觀看敏捷的帝王蜻蜓完成蛻變的過程,欣賞倉鴞悄然無聲靠近獵物的潛行方式,並捕捉一隻流浪的蠑螈縱身一躍跳入深淵的驚險飛躍.

programme.title: Airborne 1 #3
programme.desc: Check in with animals who are winners at the aerial mating game. Take flight with a bee crafting a custom love potion, watch a draco lizard soar to fend off rivals, and witness the graceful pas de deux that bonds a pair of Japanese cranes for life.

programme.title: 空中翱翔 #3
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與那些在空中交配遊戲中勝出的動物碰面,與一隻正調製專屬的愛情藥水蜜蜂一起起飛.觀看一隻飛蜥為了抵禦對手而展翼滑翔,並見證一對日本丹頂鶴透過優雅的雙人舞姿締結一生的羈絆.

programme.title: Airborne 1 #4
programme.desc: Plot a course for adventure as animals go on remarkable journeys through the skies. Navigate a wooden labyrinth with a speedy goshawk, join a sandgrouses trek to a distant watering hole, and see a murmuration of starlings mesmerize their nemesis.

programme.title: 空中翱翔 #4
programme.desc: 看動物穿越天空展開非凡的旅程.穿梭在木製迷宮中的迅捷蒼鷹,加入沙雞艱辛遠行到遙遠水源的跋涉,並觀賞一群椋鳥形成的壯觀集體盤旋,迷惑牠們的天敵.

programme.title: Wild Sky 1 #1 [Eng/Man]
programme.desc: Scan the Australian skies, which regularly deliver some of the worlds most volatile weather. Await cooling monsoon rains, watch lightning ignite vast wildfires, and marvel at the ingenious adaptations that help wildlife deal with these extremes.

programme.title: 狂野天空 #1 [英/普]
programme.desc: 抬頭觀看澳洲的天空,它經常為世界帶來最極端的天氣現象.與眾生一起等待清涼的季風雨降臨,看看閃電如何引燃大規模的野火,並驚嘆不同物種為適應這些極端環境,所展現的奇妙生存智慧.

programme.title: Wild Sky 1 #2 [Eng/Man]
programme.desc: Experience the powerful, colourful phenomena that swirl across the heavens in North America. Watch polar bears search for food under the aurora borealis, map the frigid path of a polar vortex, and elude violent tornadoes with a prairie dog family.

programme.title: 狂野天空 #2 [英/普]
programme.desc: 仰望北美洲的天際,體驗強大而絢麗的自然現象.見證北極熊在極光下尋找食物,追蹤極地渦旋的冰冷路徑,並跟隨草原犬鼠家族躲避猛烈的龍捲風.

programme.title: 朝暮動物誌 #2 [英/普]
programme.desc: 夏至影響亞洲動物,令越南獼猴進入涼快的水中,使鶴在寒冷的青藏高原上跳舞,並激發一種奇怪的魚出來散步.

programme.title: Dawn to Dusk 1 #3 [Eng/Man]
programme.desc: See how one animal familys tragedy is anothers holiday dinner as New Zealands mainland and island creatures, including penguins, flightless birds, sea lions, and sharks, battle to feed and protect their young in this marine environment.

programme.title: 朝暮動物誌 #3 [英/普]
programme.desc: 新西蘭的聖誕節只是夏天裡的一天.雖然標誌性的鷸鴕躲避陽光,但海豹,黃眼企鵝和海豚卻享受長時間日照下充裕的額外餵食時間.

programme.title: Dawn to Dusk 1 #4 [Eng/Man]
programme.desc: Find out which creatures survive and whose luck will run out as animal mothers and moms-to-be struggle with sweltering temperatures, lurking predators, mating season, and drought on a day that proves to be no holiday.

programme.title: 朝暮動物誌 #4 [英/普]
programme.desc: 印度次大陸的母親節象徵旱季於斯里蘭卡開始,同時於印度結束.對於一隻孟加拉虎媽媽來說,是時候訓練她的幼崽去狩獵了,而獅子和眼鏡蛇則忙於交配.

programme.title: The Living Beach 1 #6
programme.desc: The beaches of California are some of the most beautiful in the world, but are they falling out of balance due to mankinds effects on nature? What does it take for the magnificent fauna of the Pacific Coast to keep living... on the living beach?

programme.title: 海灘生命線 #6
programme.desc: 加州的海灘是世上最美麗的海灘之一,但由於人類對大自然的影響,它們是否會失去平衡?太平洋海岸壯麗的動物群如何在海灘生命線上繼續生活?

programme.title: Brazil Untamed 1 #1 [Eng/Man]
programme.desc: Explore the southern edge of the Pantanal, where brown capuchin monkeys live in their own Garden of Eden. Dry season in the highlands treats them well until a drought dries up their food sources. Can an industrious agouti save them from starvation?

programme.title: 我愛「森」巴 #1 [英/普]
programme.desc: 在潘塔納爾的南部邊界,有著世上獨一無二最大的熱帶濕地,野生動植物的多樣性使科學家們爭相瞭解動物的各種互動方式.博多克納山的高地是隱密的潘塔納爾濕地的入口.那裡的水十分清澈,因由超過6億年歷史的石灰岩所形成過濾層,為這些溪流中的生命提供了一個清晰的門戶. 瀑布,凝灰岩水壩,洞穴和純淨的河流,能見...

programme.title: Brazil Untamed 1 #2 [Eng/Man]
programme.desc: Every year, the southern wetlands of the Pantanal become a bird paradise as over 650 species of rare and iconic birds congregate here for the breeding season.

programme.title: 我愛「森」巴 #2 [英/普]
programme.desc: 潘塔納爾的南部濕地於每年都成為鳥類天堂,超過650種珍稀和標誌性的鳥類在繁殖季節中聚集.

programme.title: Brazil Untamed 1 #3 [Eng/Man]
programme.desc: Trek through the forests and savannahs of the Pantanals Nhecolândia region, which is home to noisy herds of peccaries. Follow these pig-like mammals on their daily food-foraging routes, and run into roseate spoonbills and capybaras along the way.

programme.title: 我愛「森」巴 #3 [英/普]
programme.desc: 在潘塔納爾濕地的中心,有一個人跡罕至的偏遠地區.沒有人為干預,使這裡成為三百隻馳名的白唇西貒的棲息地.這些大型類豬哺乳類動物能長到四十五公斤,下巴下有白色條紋,因獨特外觀而得名.

programme.title: Brazil Untamed 1 #4 [Eng/Man]
programme.desc: In the heart of Brazil, the largest cat in the Americas, the magnificent jaguar, reigns over a magical land filled with natural beauty and diversity.

programme.title: 我愛「森」巴 #4 [英/普]
programme.desc: 在巴西的中心有著美洲最大的貓科動物- 驚豔的美洲虎,雄霸充滿自然美景和多樣性的神奇土地.

programme.title: Osprey: Sea Raptor [Eng/Man]
programme.desc: Wade into a saltwater marsh along the Connecticut River to witness the heartwarming reunion of two ospreys whove been mates for a decade. Witness their highs and lows over a single summer as they raise their chicks and dodge a host of predators.

programme.title: 魚鷹: 海洋迅猛禽 [英/普]
programme.desc: 一對老魚鷹回到康州鹽沼的家中.牠們在整個夏天必須與敵人作戰,忍耐惡劣天氣,捕獵千百條魚,只為養育下一代.

programme.title: Airborne 1 #1
programme.desc: Watch beginners make their first leap into the air, like an Andean condor who must attend flight school before spreading its wings. Meet oddballs who soar without feathers and marvel at a peregrine falcons speed as it dives to catch its prey.

programme.title: 空中翱翔 #1
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​觀看初學者第一次躍入空中的瞬間,就像一隻安地斯神鷹必須先去飛行學校接受訓練,然後才有可能展開雙翼翱翔.遇見那些沒有羽毛卻能高飛的奇特傢伙,並驚嘆遊隼高速俯衝捕捉獵物的驚人速度,也讚嘆牠下墜時抓取獵物的猛烈迅捷.

programme.title: Airborne 1 #2
programme.desc: Go hunting with flyers who excel at making mid-air catches. Watch the metamorphosis of the acrobatic emperor dragonfly, admire the barn owls stealthy approach to prey, and catch a wandering salamanders death-defying leap into the abyss.

programme.title: 空中翱翔 #2
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與那些在半空中善於抓獵的飛行者一起出獵,觀看敏捷的帝王蜻蜓完成蛻變的過程,欣賞倉鴞悄然無聲靠近獵物的潛行方式,並捕捉一隻流浪的蠑螈縱身一躍跳入深淵的驚險飛躍.

programme.title: Airborne 1 #3
programme.desc: Check in with animals who are winners at the aerial mating game. Take flight with a bee crafting a custom love potion, watch a draco lizard soar to fend off rivals, and witness the graceful pas de deux that bonds a pair of Japanese cranes for life.

programme.title: 空中翱翔 #3
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與那些在空中交配遊戲中勝出的動物碰面,與一隻正調製專屬的愛情藥水蜜蜂一起起飛.觀看一隻飛蜥為了抵禦對手而展翼滑翔,並見證一對日本丹頂鶴透過優雅的雙人舞姿締結一生的羈絆.

programme.title: Airborne 1 #4
programme.desc: Plot a course for adventure as animals go on remarkable journeys through the skies. Navigate a wooden labyrinth with a speedy goshawk, join a sandgrouses trek to a distant watering hole, and see a murmuration of starlings mesmerize their nemesis.

programme.title: 空中翱翔 #4
programme.desc: 看動物穿越天空展開非凡的旅程.穿梭在木製迷宮中的迅捷蒼鷹,加入沙雞艱辛遠行到遙遠水源的跋涉,並觀賞一群椋鳥形成的壯觀集體盤旋,迷惑牠們的天敵.

programme.title: Wild Sky 1 #1 [Eng/Man]
programme.desc: Scan the Australian skies, which regularly deliver some of the worlds most volatile weather. Await cooling monsoon rains, watch lightning ignite vast wildfires, and marvel at the ingenious adaptations that help wildlife deal with these extremes.

programme.title: 狂野天空 #1 [英/普]
programme.desc: 抬頭觀看澳洲的天空,它經常為世界帶來最極端的天氣現象.與眾生一起等待清涼的季風雨降臨,看看閃電如何引燃大規模的野火,並驚嘆不同物種為適應這些極端環境,所展現的奇妙生存智慧.

programme.title: Wild Sky 1 #2 [Eng/Man]
programme.desc: Experience the powerful, colourful phenomena that swirl across the heavens in North America. Watch polar bears search for food under the aurora borealis, map the frigid path of a polar vortex, and elude violent tornadoes with a prairie dog family.

programme.title: 狂野天空 #2 [英/普]
programme.desc: 仰望北美洲的天際,體驗強大而絢麗的自然現象.見證北極熊在極光下尋找食物,追蹤極地渦旋的冰冷路徑,並跟隨草原犬鼠家族躲避猛烈的龍捲風.

programme.title: 雙截棍[普]
programme.desc: 本片講述的是由陳天星飾演的電影動作導演東方哲深受世界功夫巨星李小龍的影響,決心要自編自導自演一部雙截棍電影來向李小龍宗師致敬.因沉溺於雙截棍劇作的東方哲不能自拔,導致家庭破裂,妻子離定出走,兒子離奇失踪...

programme.desc: Every city has its legends and this citys legend is the Ferryman. It is said that a person who takes on this role can help eliminate pain and sorrow from the world. Chen Mo, a bar owner, and his...

programme.title: 擺渡人[粵/普]
programme.desc: 每座城市都有屬於自己的傳奇,這座城市的傳奇就是擺渡人.據說,擺渡人能消除世間痛苦.酒吧老闆陳末和拍擋管春,平時看起來吊兒郎當,但其實是金牌擺渡人,空手接白刃,人肉千斤頂,只要你預約,就無所不能...

programme.title: The Pye-Dog[Can/Man]
programme.desc: Wangs father, being the rising star in the triad, is back from overseas to expand his power in Hong Kong, with his other attempt - to get Wang back...

programme.title: 野良犬[粵/普]
programme.desc: 謊言的掩飾下,陳滿堆與倔強的宏建立起真摰的友誼,打開了Miss張一直封閉的心扉,一同走進了屬於他們三人的天空.但隨著宏的父親鈕喬澤出現,美麗的謊言被拆穿,殘酷的真相被揭開,一直不為人知的真實身份終於曝光.

programme.title: 碟仙詭譚[普]
programme.desc: 在某公司任職的楊天樂,某天早晨接到老同學韓陽的電話,邀請大家到一處位於荒郊野嶺的老別墅聚會.約定的當天,天樂乘坐蔣為平的車來到別墅,老同學們三三兩兩到來.在這片幽靜的角落,他們有說有笑,好不吵鬧.誰知當聚會正在高超之際,一場暴雨突然而至,攪擾了眾人的雅興...

programme.desc: 財神到分為三個不同的故事,財神總管奉命散財,派遣兩位財神下凡,嗜酒財神化身為十歲的女孩小嬌,把一億元送給善心的教師楊素娟;女財神為了給予盲人鋼琴家一塊錢,在日夕相處之下對他動了凡心.財神總管親自下凡,遇上了傾慕公司太子爺的倒楣上班族OL徐傑與她的好友董晶晶,究竟失憶和失去法力...

programme.desc: Ming Li (Tan Jun Yan) is having financial problem to invest in video art and the production video of his long time model girlfriend called Ya Xi (Lai Ya Yan)...

programme.desc: 單親媽媽Grace在開車載其女兒婷婷上學後,被匪徒霍德能等綁架,匪幫在她家搜掠後把她鎖在荒地一個舊貨櫃中.驚慌失措的Grace盡力接通一部已被砸毀的電話,奇跡地連線到財務公司職員阿邦的手機,而同時阿邦正趕往機場與姐姐Jeanie會合,送邦的兒子出國升學...

programme.desc: 蒙毅將軍是位秦朝皇帝手下勇猛又忠心的悍將,他被安排保護從朝鮮到來嫁秦皇帝為妾的玉漱公主.玉漱公主為了避免她的國家受到侵略,答應了這門婚事.迎親過程中劫難不斷,蒙毅始終克盡職守全力保護著公主,兩人情不自禁對對方產生了感情,但由於兩人的身分,他們一直把這分感覺藏在心中...

programme.desc: Two old rivals, Sammo and Lau Ka Wing meet every 10 years to find out whose weaponryskills are better. These duels always end up in a draw and as the two warriors are aging they decide to each take...

programme.title: 搏命單刀奪命槍[粵/普]
programme.desc: 刀王和槍王的武功不相伯仲,於是各自收徒傳授武學,圖比高低.十五年前他們手下敗將捲土重來,武功突飛猛進,刀王槍王俱斃命其大刀下.徒弟們為師復仇後,竟承繼並師鬥氣本色,比試又再開始.

programme.title: When I Look Upon The Stars[Can/Man]
天旋地戀[粵/普]
programme.desc: 世事往往出人意表,特別是愛情.一直對愛情滿懷信心的祺飛往東京探望留學日本的女朋友June,竟發現她與他那不成才的老友Sam相戀.祺怎也不相信在自己仍然忘不了June的時候,愛上一個萍水相逢的女子,更與她玩了一個廿四小時的戀愛遊戲...

She meets and learns from researchers and vets about what it takes to bring a species back from extinction.

Extraordinary Animals[Eng]
programme.desc: Many scientists believe curiosity is a key driving force in evolution leading to both physical and behavioural adaptations and driving the development of new environments. This episode features some surprisingly intelligent and uniquely curious animals: Australian Sea Lions, Parrots, Numbats, Portia Spiders, Brushtail Possums and Sea Snakes.

programme.title: 奇珍異獸[英]
programme.desc: 許多科學家認為，好奇心是進化的關鍵驅動力，它不僅能帶來生理和行為上的適應性變化，也能推動新環境的形成。本集將介紹一些智力驚人且有獨特好奇心的動物：澳洲海獅、鸚鵡、袋食蟻獸、孔蛛、帚尾袋貂和海蛇。

programme.title: OSIM (TVB特約合作伙伴) 呈獻 :2026特戰英豪倫敦大師賽[直播][普/粵]
programme.desc: 《2026特戰英豪倫敦大師賽》匯聚來自四大賽區的電競戰隊，兩支頂尖隊伍披荊斬棘，迎來終極對壘，展現精準射擊與角色技能的完美結合。TVB翡翠台、明珠台分途直播採用BO5賽制的總決賽，主持曾展望、戴祖儀、林沚羿請來資深電競賽事評述員老星、「特戰英豪」評述員noc、嘉賓麥玲玲，一同與觀眾欣賞賽事。爭逐冠軍榮耀之前，集結決賽舞台的兩支戰隊，還會於全新地圖上展開較量，藉表演賽熱身。

programme.title: Blue World[Eng]
programme.desc: In this episode, the Blue World team travels to Vermont, USA. In the 1800s, large quantities of materials could be transported by water to and from New York via a system of locks. By controlling the water level in the locks, large boats can pass through. The crew find the wrecks of old canal boats remarkably well-preserved in the cold fresh water. Then, the biology of pipefish and seahorses is explored. It's really amazing!

programme.title: 藍海世界[英]
programme.desc: 今集, 攝製隊前往美國‧佛蒙特.在1800年代, 大量材料貨物可經過水路進出紐約. 透過控制水閘的水位, 或升或降, 大船也能駛過. 攝製隊發現古老運河船殘骸給寒冷淡水保存得很好, 還會揭示尖嘴魚及海馬的資料, 很精彩！

programme.title: Shark Dive TV[Eng]
programme.desc: In this episode, we dive with Greenland Sharks in the cold waters of Canada's Gulf of St Lawrence. We'll get a lesson on shark biology. The fact that sharks have survived so long demonstrates the incredible effectiveness of their anatomy. Lastly, we take a Deeper Dive with a focus on Longtail Carpet Sharks and Basking Sharks.

programme.title: 鯊魚百科[英]
programme.desc: 今集，我們與格陵蘭鯊一起在加拿大聖羅倫斯灣的寒冷水域潛水。我們將上一堂關於鯊魚生理學的課。鯊魚能存活這麼久的事實證明了牠們的結構具有令人難以置信的有效性。最後，我們深入探討長尾鬚鯊和姥鯊。

programme.desc: Nuanchan is a famous and highly respected spiritual medium in a rural village in Thailand. She wants to train her niece, Ploy, to succeed her and Ploy needs to remain a virgin. When Ploy falls in love with her childhood friend Tul, their lives are in danger as the secret of the spiritual world is being unveiled.

programme.title: Waning Moon
programme.desc: 潘辰是泰國一處偏僻的村莊裡受眾人敬仰和有名氣的靈媒。她希望她的姪女小普保有處女之身,以繼承她村內靈媒的地位。然而,當小普愛上青梅竹馬的圖恩後,靈界的秘密被揭開,他們的性命也面臨威脅。

programme.title: Endless Love
programme.desc: A young girl encounters a novelist in a bar and quickly falls in love with him. However, it turns out she has fallen into a trap set up by the novelist and his ex-girlfriend who is a ghost with a disfigured face. The journey of revenge and ultimate terror has just begun!

programme.title: 錯愛迷蹤
programme.desc: 跟朋友在酒吧喝酒的女孩邂逅恐怖小說家,兩人一見鍾情感情迅速升溫。原來女孩已悄然落入驚天迷局,全因小說家的前女友是個毀容的女鬼,她借用人面還魂復仇,與前男友聯手開啟奪命驚嚇。

programme.title: Model Family #2
programme.desc: A single-parent family (Yu Xiang and Tong Tong) moves into a new neighbourhood where everyone’s life seems perfect. However, while things may look rosy on the outside, dark secrets and horror raid each family from the inside, and nothing really are as they seem.

programme.title: 模範家庭 #2
programme.desc: 一個單親媽媽郁香和她的女兒童童搬進了一個住宅區展開新生活。區內住著一個個看似幸福美滿的家庭,背後卻藏著許多不為人知的秘密,而人性的黑暗面亦一步步被揭開. . .

programme.title: They Wait in the Dark
programme.desc: Amy and her adopted son Adrian flee from her abusive ex-girlfriend Judith. Seeking refuge in an abandoned farmhouse in Amys Kansas hometown, they confront a supernatural evil force from her dark past that haunts Adrian. As Judith pursues them, Amy and Adrian must face the dangers both outside and within the house.

programme.title: They Wait in the Dark
programme.desc: Amy和養子Adrian逃離了虐待她的前女友Judith,躲在Amy堪薩斯家鄉的一棟廢棄農舍中,卻遭遇到因Amy的暗黑歷史所引發的邪惡超自然力量,讓Adrian感到恐懼。當Judith步步進逼時,Am..

programme.title: Evie
programme.desc: When young Evie discovers a cursed necklace washed up on the beach, she is unaware of the malevolent force tied to it. As the necklaces dark power begins to grip her, she inadvertently awakens a deadly water demon intent on claiming her and everyone she holds dear.

programme.title: Evie
programme.desc: 當年輕的Evie在海灘上發現一條受詛咒的項鍊時,她並未察覺其中隱藏的邪惡力量。隨著項鍊的暗黑力量逐漸侵蝕她的意志,她無意中喚醒了恐怖的水魔,而這個水魔將威脅到她和她所愛之人的性命。

programme.title: Zhong Kui Exorcism
programme.desc: After hunting fox demons, Zhong Kui returns to Heyang Village only to discover that his lover and neighbours have been slaughtered. Following the trail to Lingdu City, he encounters Princess Liu Li, who has been cursed into a half-human, half-monster form. Armed with his demon-slaying sword, he battles the demons to save Liu Li and protect the city.

programme.title: 鍾馗降魔
programme.desc: 鍾馗收伏狐妖後回到河陽村,卻發現戀人芊芊與鄉親慘遭屠殺。為追查真兇,他下山前往陵都城尋找線索,途中邂逅因妖魔所害而化為半人半妖的琉璃公主。鍾馗揮舞降魔劍斬妖除魔,誓要拯救琉璃公主並守護城池安寧。

programme.title: Waning Moon
programme.desc: Nuanchan is a famous and highly respected spiritual medium in a rural village in Thailand. She wants to train her niece, Ploy, to succeed her and Ploy needs to remain a virgin. When Ploy falls in love with her childhood friend Tul, their lives are in danger as the secret of the spiritual world is being unveiled.

programme.title: Waning Moon
programme.desc: 潘辰是泰國一處偏僻的村莊裡受眾人敬仰和有名氣的靈媒。她希望她的姪女小普保有處女之身,以繼承她村內靈媒的地位。然而,當小普愛上青梅竹馬的圖恩後,靈界的秘密被揭開,他們的性命也面臨威脅。

programme.title: Anak Perjanjian Syaitan 2
programme.desc: Haunted since childhood, orphan Azlinda believes her torment stems from her parents dark history. Her friends Zurina, Wati, and Ustaz join forces to end her suffering, but a malevolent demon interrupts their efforts. Will Azlinda succeed in severing the cursed ties that bind her, or is she destined to remain trapped in darkness forever?

programme.title: Anak Perjanjian Syaitan 2 (aka Offspring of the Devils Pact 2)
programme.desc: 孤兒Azlinda從小就受到鬼魂的困擾,相信這些折磨與父母的暗黑歷史密切相關。她的朋友Zurina、Wati和Ustaz攜手合作,希望結束她的痛苦,但卻被一個邪惡的惡魔阻撓。Azlinda能否成功斬斷..

programme.title: Model Family #3
programme.desc: A single-parent family (Yu Xiang and Tong Tong) moves into a new neighbourhood where everyone’s life seems perfect. However, while things may look rosy on the outside, dark secrets and horror raid each family from the inside, and nothing really are as they seem.

programme.title: 模範家庭 #3
programme.desc: 一個單親媽媽郁香和她的女兒童童搬進了一個住宅區展開新生活。區內住著一個個看似幸福美滿的家庭,背後卻藏著許多不為人知的秘密,而人性的黑暗面亦一步步被揭開. . .

programme.title: Sinister - Live Art Model
programme.desc: Jing Wen, a struggling drama student, takes on a modelling job to help cover her tuition costs. As she becomes a model for an enigmatic artist specializing in expressive human body sketches, Jing Wen accidentally uncovers a shocking truth, plunging her into a desperate fight for survival.

programme.title: 罪慾 - 人體模特
programme.desc: 靜雯是一名努力奮鬥的戲劇學生,為了應付學費開支而接受了一份模特兒的工作。然而,當她為一位專門從事表現性人體素描的神秘藝術家擔任模特兒時,靜雯意外地揭露了一個驚人真相,更將她推向生死邊緣。

programme.title: Ten Minutes to Midnight
programme.desc: Amy gets bitten by a rabid bat during her last graveyard shift as a veteran punk rock disc jockey. When a storm traps Amy, her mysterious replacement and an anxious staff inside their small-town radio station, reality starts to distort as they go deeper into the graveyard shift…

programme.title: Ten Minutes to Midnight
programme.desc: 資深搖滾音樂唱片騎師Amy在擔任最後一次深宵節目主持期間,被一隻蝙蝠咬傷。一場暴風雨將Amy,她的神秘接班人和一位焦慮不安的工作人員困在小鎮的電台裡,在接近深宵時,情況變得更糟…

programme.title: Rooftop
programme.desc: A group of friends invites Paul to a secret party on their campus rooftop. When a prank accidentally kills Paul, the friends cover up the incident and promised never to disclose it. Paul vows to take revenge by becoming a vicious ghost to haunt them into taking responsibility for their actions.

programme.title: Rooftop
programme.desc: 幾位朋友邀請保羅參加在學校天台舉行的秘密派對。當保羅因一場惡作劇而意外身亡時,這群朋友決定隱瞞此事,並承諾會永遠保密。保羅誓要復仇,並變成厲鬼把他們嚇翻,讓他們為自己的行為負責。

programme.title: 3AM - The Hospital
programme.desc: A woman in hospital accidentally discovers her husband’s affair. On the verge of breakdown, she begins to encounter a “stranger” who claims to also be a victim of the affair. Is this entity a figment of her imagination or a vengeful spirit? As she struggles to control her thoughts and actions, can she stop herself from hurting those around her?

programme.title: 凌晨三點鐘 - 醫院
programme.desc: 一個被送院治療的女人,意外發現老公出軌。精神瀕臨崩潰的她一直被一個“陌生人幹擾,而他也自稱為這婚外情的另一受害者。這“陌生人究竟是幻覺還是惡靈? 在她竭力控制自己的思緒和行為當下,能否制止自己傷..

programme.title: Hide Seek
programme.desc: Thirteen years after an explosion in an abandoned building killed their friend Noo Aon, Tong and his group return to the site—now their university campus. When a girl who looks exactly like Noo Aon appears, a childhood game turns into a lethal ritual. One by one, the friends are hunted by a vengeful spirit determined to settle a long-overdue score.

programme.title: Hide Seek (aka The Last Hide Seek)
programme.desc: 十三年前,廢棄大廈的一場爆炸奪走了童的好友諾安。十三年後,童與昔日的朋友們重返故地,此地如今已成為他們就讀的大學校園。當一名與諾安容貌相同的女孩出現,兒時的遊戲化為索命的詛咒。復仇的惡靈再度甦醒,逐一..

programme.title: Anak Perjanjian Syaitan 2
programme.desc: Haunted since childhood, orphan Azlinda believes her torment stems from her parents dark history. Her friends Zurina, Wati, and Ustaz join forces to end her suffering, but a malevolent demon interrupts their efforts. Will Azlinda succeed in severing the cursed ties that bind her, or is she destined to remain trapped in darkness forever?

programme.title: Anak Perjanjian Syaitan 2 (aka Offspring of the Devils Pact 2)
programme.desc: 孤兒Azlinda從小就受到鬼魂的困擾,相信這些折磨與父母的暗黑歷史密切相關。她的朋友Zurina、Wati和Ustaz攜手合作,希望結束她的痛苦,但卻被一個邪惡的惡魔阻撓。Azlinda能否成功斬斷..

programme.title: 宮心計 #32 [粵]
programme.desc: 雲追問霞是否早已得悉順非她親兒，霞向她坦白；贄對外宣稱怡在佛寺祈福，由他代理朝政。好對鈴竟和贄同流合污感失望，決定完成怡交託，怡來到矩州往見杞王；好來訪驚見鄭昏倒地上，更被鈴打暈，好醒來後發現鄭死去。

programme.title: 宮心計 #33 [粵]
programme.desc: (大結局)贄煽動將好判罪，好以身懷帝裔保住性命。鈴和贄見證尚宮局眾人利誘飛燕誣陷鈴，將眾囚禁天牢。怡率大軍入城，贄把罪責推到鈴身上。雲和鋒出宮前，霞把祥遺物中找到的嬰兒藥方交予雲，好向怡提出三個要求。

programme.title: Deep In The Realm Of Conscience #1 [Can]
宮心計2深宮計 #1 [粵]
programme.desc: 平王李隆基聯同太平公主，成功誅滅企圖臨朝攝政的韋后，擁護父親李旦重登帝位。元玥隨雜耍團在長安賣藝，遭竊賊搶劫，何離擊退竊賊反與元玥結怨。任三恕賞識何離智勇兼備，力邀其加入龍武軍。太平得知隆基招募龍武軍，指二人已背道而馳。王蓁御前獻舞表演，突然遭人暗中破壞。元玥順利入宮，竟當眾向尚宮局之首章瓊香自薦加入司膳房……何離深夜暗中與一神秘人會面。瓊香與尚宮局四司陪同賢妃前往霓裳閣檢視衣飾，驚見駭人一幕……

programme.title: WONG FEI HUNG - MASTER OF KUNG FU #24 [Can]
我師傅係黃飛鴻 #24 [粵]
programme.desc: 龍答應讓桂留在佛山，但不得踏出家門半步。如、婷覺天性情大變，心灰意冷，決離家出走到寶芝林暫住。鴻克復心理障礙，替英針灸，眾人亦各出奇謀希望能救醒英，鴻感激。程醫生替英診治，卻開出毒藥，千鈞一髮之際，鴻收到一神秘字條，及時救英一命；未幾，程醫生慘遭滅口。嫻助桂見鴻，鴻懷疑程醫生之死跟龍有關，桂不信。鴻成功用針灸救醒英，英證實殺九的兇手是龍。鴻勸天提防龍，天執迷不悔。英等得悉龍偷運國寶賣給洋人，鴻到貨倉阻止交易，遭天開槍射擊。

programme.title: WONG FEI HUNG - MASTER OF KUNG FU #25 [Can]
我師傅係黃飛鴻 #25 [粵]
programme.desc: (大結局)英替鴻取出子彈，鴻無生命危險。榮偷聽到龍的交易地點，英通知達一同前往，英突然接到神秘字條，得知交易地藏有炸藥，及時逃生，達則受重傷。英再收到龍交易國寶的消息，怎料中龍圈套，天被槍殺。原來龍早懷疑是天通風報信給英，天臨死前將龍的罪證告之鴻。鴻、英趕到阻止龍交易，二人合力打敗龍。天留下遺書向各人交代一切，如等知怪錯天。桂帶嫻到香港生活，鴻依依不捨。英決跟寶到外國學西洋醫術，將寶芝林交給鴻打理。若干年後，眾人再次在佛山團聚。

programme.title: 太極 #22 [粵]
programme.desc: 馬傷癒再賽，輕鬆勝出。星與馬爭奪華盟會主席，星被馬打敗。傲安排證人令星認為洋是被馬所殺。在華盟會就職典禮上，星指馬是殺洋兇手。馬成功逃走，但卓亦因此被收監。星帶華盟會眾人追捕馬，更親自將他踢下山崖。

programme.title: 太極 #23 [粵]
programme.desc: 星發現規原諒自己，向她求婚更獲答允。星向威質問卻反被威迫，指要將他污辱規之事公開。馬死裡逃生，遇上山賊將地主凌老爺捉去，年與馬合作救出凌。星終明白洋的死因。星竟當眾悔婚，說出在上海佔有了規的人是自己。

programme.desc: 平王李隆基聯同太平公主，成功誅滅企圖臨朝攝政的韋后，擁護父親李旦重登帝位。元玥隨雜耍團在長安賣藝，遭竊賊搶劫，何離擊退竊賊反與元玥結怨。任三恕賞識何離智勇兼備，力邀其加入龍武軍。太平得知隆基招募龍武軍，指二人已背道而馳。王蓁御前獻舞表演，突然遭人暗中破壞。元玥順利入宮，竟當眾向尚宮局之首章瓊香自薦加入司膳房……何離深夜暗中與一神秘人會面。瓊香與尚宮局四司陪同賢妃前往霓裳閣檢視衣飾，驚見駭人一幕……

programme.title: WONG FEI HUNG - MASTER OF KUNG FU #24 [Can]
我師傅係黃飛鴻 #24 [粵]
programme.desc: 龍答應讓桂留在佛山，但不得踏出家門半步。如、婷覺天性情大變，心灰意冷，決離家出走到寶芝林暫住。鴻克復心理障礙，替英針灸，眾人亦各出奇謀希望能救醒英，鴻感激。程醫生替英診治，卻開出毒藥，千鈞一髮之際，鴻收到一神秘字條，及時救英一命；未幾，程醫生慘遭滅口。嫻助桂見鴻，鴻懷疑程醫生之死跟龍有關，桂不信。鴻成功用針灸救醒英，英證實殺九的兇手是龍。鴻勸天提防龍，天執迷不悔。英等得悉龍偷運國寶賣給洋人，鴻到貨倉阻止交易，遭天開槍射擊。

programme.title: WONG FEI HUNG - MASTER OF KUNG FU #25 [Can]
我師傅係黃飛鴻 #25 [粵]
programme.desc: (大結局)英替鴻取出子彈，鴻無生命危險。榮偷聽到龍的交易地點，英通知達一同前往，英突然接到神秘字條，得知交易地藏有炸藥，及時逃生，達則受重傷。英再收到龍交易國寶的消息，怎料中龍圈套，天被槍殺。原來龍早懷疑是天通風報信給英，天臨死前將龍的罪證告之鴻。鴻、英趕到阻止龍交易，二人合力打敗龍。天留下遺書向各人交代一切，如等知怪錯天。桂帶嫻到香港生活，鴻依依不捨。英決跟寶到外國學西洋醫術，將寶芝林交給鴻打理。若干年後，眾人再次在佛山團聚。

programme.title: 太極 #22 [粵]
programme.desc: 馬傷癒再賽，輕鬆勝出。星與馬爭奪華盟會主席，星被馬打敗。傲安排證人令星認為洋是被馬所殺。在華盟會就職典禮上，星指馬是殺洋兇手。馬成功逃走，但卓亦因此被收監。星帶華盟會眾人追捕馬，更親自將他踢下山崖。

programme.title: 太極 #23 [粵]
programme.desc: 星發現規原諒自己，向她求婚更獲答允。星向威質問卻反被威迫，指要將他污辱規之事公開。馬死裡逃生，遇上山賊將地主凌老爺捉去，年與馬合作救出凌。星終明白洋的死因。星竟當眾悔婚，說出在上海佔有了規的人是自己。

programme.title: 宮心計 #32 [粵]
programme.desc: 雲追問霞是否早已得悉順非她親兒，霞向她坦白；贄對外宣稱怡在佛寺祈福，由他代理朝政。好對鈴竟和贄同流合污感失望，決定完成怡交託，怡來到矩州往見杞王；好來訪驚見鄭昏倒地上，更被鈴打暈，好醒來後發現鄭死去。

programme.title: 宮心計 #33 [粵]
programme.desc: (大結局)贄煽動將好判罪，好以身懷帝裔保住性命。鈴和贄見證尚宮局眾人利誘飛燕誣陷鈴，將眾囚禁天牢。怡率大軍入城，贄把罪責推到鈴身上。雲和鋒出宮前，霞把祥遺物中找到的嬰兒藥方交予雲，好向怡提出三個要求。

programme.title: 巴黎戀歌 #30 [普]
programme.desc: 旅法鋼琴家於蔓芝漫步巴黎街頭，用街頭藝人的樂器演奏了起來。這熟悉的琴聲，吸引咖啡館裡忙於招待客人的紀瑋走來。十幾年前，在鋼琴老師賀語彤的悉心調教下，青梅竹馬的於蔓芝和紀瑋成為了上海音界的一對金童玉女。

programme.title: 醉拳蘇乞兒 #1 [普/粵]
programme.desc: 蘇記酒廠大少爺蘇燦生性不羈，沉迷武學，常常與人結怨，造成日後的禍根。蘇燦為爭得商會會長，四處拉選票，斧頭幫主豹為報花炮會之仇，便與蘇燦爭做會長，最後，因村民不滿蘇燦的開除工人，故蘇燦落選...

programme.title: 再見愛人 #22 [普/粵]
programme.desc: 鍾文基因追捕一名綁架人質案逃犯時開槍誤傷人命，從而產生了心理障礙，對槍充滿了恐懼，無奈之下只好辭職去應聘一大公司出任某大廈保安主管。一個偶然的機會，韋玉蓮闖入了他的生活，兩人由鬥氣冤家結為夫妻...

programme.desc: 蘇記酒廠大少爺蘇燦生性不羈，沉迷武學，常常與人結怨，造成日後的禍根。蘇燦為爭得商會會長，四處拉選票，斧頭幫主豹為報花炮會之仇，便與蘇燦爭做會長，最後，因村民不滿蘇燦的開除工人，故蘇燦落選...

programme.title: 再見愛人 #22 [普/粵]

Play Whats The Difference? with the ZooMoo crew and discover why animals think its cool to be different!
